descriptionChirho: The ordinal adjective 'sixth' used to indicate position in a sequence, applied to hours of the day, seals, angels, bowls, and other enumerated items in both narrative and apocalyptic contexts. All occurrences share the same core meaning across masculine (Adj-NMS, Adj-DMS) and feminine (Adj-AFS, Adj-NFS, Adj-GFS) inflections. Multilingual evidence confirms uniform rendering: Spanish 'sexto/sexta,' Hindi 'छठवें/छठी,' Arabic 'السَّادِسُ/السَّادِسَةِ,' Korean '여섯째,' Swahili 'sita/wa-sita.' No semantic distinction exists between the two clusters—only grammatical gender and case agreement differ.
